The provided sample case includes XML with namespaces where certain nodes do not have a namespace specified. When `.asPath()` is called on a node without a specific namespace, it loops in the `org.apache.commons.jxpath` package.

The failing test `testInnerEmptyNamespaceDOM` in `JXPath154Test` class is related to testing paths in the Document Object Model (DOM) model. The test calls the `doTest` method with parameters `b:foo/test`, `DocumentContainer.MODEL_DOM`, and `/b:foo[1]/test[1]`. The model used here is `org.apache.commons.jxpath.xml.DocumentContainer.MODEL_DOM`.

By analyzing the test and related code snippets, it seems that the issue may be related to how namespaces are handled or resolved in the `DocumentContainer` class when processing paths in the DOM model.
